previous_last_sync.summary: Capoworks ECU now invalidates a pending priming-pulse request when the ignition is switched off, so a delayed prime from an earlier key cycle cannot fire after key-off or during a later key cycle. An already-opened priming pulse is still allowed to finish and close normally. The existing Priming Pulse page is updated to describe this behavior.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU changed priming-pulse scheduling so a key-off invalidates any pending delayed prime. Previously a delayed start could still fire after the ignition was switched off, or a stale request from an earlier key cycle could run during a later one. Now a pending prime is discarded on key-off, and an already-opened pulse still receives its matching close so injectors are not left open. No tune setting changes and no user action is required; the priming delay and prime table behave as before. This is a firmware behavior change, so it applies only to builds that include it.
evidence: prime_injection.cpp: onIgnitionStateChanged now tracks m_isIgnitionOn and increments m_keyCycleGeneration under a critical section, returning early on key-off
prime_injection.cpp: onPrimeStart, onPrimeOpen and onPrimeEnd take a generation argument and reject callbacks whose generation no longer matches the current key cycle
prime_injection.h: new members m_isIgnitionOn, m_primeOpened, m_keyCycleGeneration, m_pulseGeneration; adapters changed from PrimeController* to uintptr_t generation

last_sync.summary: Fuel-pump startup priming is now gated on the ignition being on. Previously the timed prime request could remain active after the ignition was switched off, holding the low-pressure pump on until the prime duration expired. With this change the prime stops on the next controller update after key-off, and each ignition-on transition starts a fresh prime interval. The recent-trigger hold and the forced-on bench request are unchanged, so Fuel pump off is still not an emergency fuel cut.

decisions.rationale: Capoworks ECU now requires the ignition to be on for the timed startup prime, so the low-pressure pump no longer stays primed after key-off. Each ignition-on transition restarts the prime interval, and the prime still ends when the configured Prime duration expires. The recent-trigger hold and the forced-on bench request are unchanged, so a recent trigger can still run the pump with the ignition off, and Fuel pump off still only clears the manual request. No tune setting or migration is required; use a build that includes this change and do not assume older or differently branded binaries behave the same way.
evidence: firmware/controllers/modules/fuel_pump/fuel_pump.cpp: isPrime now requires ignitionOn in addition to the elapsed-time window against startUpFuelPumpDuration
